plain: Called together formally, as a legislature

example.quote: Had they dissolved themseh-cs, and a new Parliament been convoked, probably many of the very opponents to the government might have been elected.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Mr. GORE, January 15, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
